heading.text: Genuine enough to trust. Sharp on the detail.
heading.accent: Bold enough to push for the best outcome

intro: I understand your position, then I plan the structure, prepare the numbers and make your best case to the right lender. Then I stay across it as things change and close the deal.

steps.label: Genuine understanding
steps.title: I understand your whole picture
steps.text: Your business, home and investments can be complex, but I make it simple. I listen first, then look at how all your lending fits together, so it is built around what you're working towards.

steps.label: Know how lenders think
steps.title: I know what the lenders need and I am bold enough to push
steps.text: Over 15 years in banking taught me how lenders decide. Before anything goes in, I work out what the lender will want to see, then prepare the numbers and your story to answer it. I am bold enough to challenge them as I have enjoyed this experience many times before.

steps.label: In your corner
steps.title: I tell you what I think, then see it through
steps.text: I won't hand you a list of options and leave you to it. I make the case, push where there's a sensible path, say so when something isn't possible, and stay involved as your plans change to see the deal through.
